gloss: oily skin; oily constitution; greasy complexion

definitions.gloss: oily skin; oily constitution; greasy complexion
definitions.explanation: A skin type characterized by excessive sebum (oil) production, resulting in a shiny or greasy appearance. Used in skincare and cosmetics contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脂性|あぶらしょう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でテカりやすい。
examples.english: I have oily skin, so my face gets shiny easily.

examples.japanese: {脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{油分|ゆぶん}→油分：25118_yubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Cosmetics with less oil are good for oily skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: When summer comes, my oily skin gets worse and I wash my face more often.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧ (oil, grease) and ⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ (nature, constitution). Describes a skin type or constitutional tendency toward excess oil production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: oily skin
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for oily skin
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: skincare for oily skin
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve oily skin

SKIN TYPES IN JAPANESE:
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ / オイリー⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: oily skin
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}{肌|はだ}→乾燥肌：16609_kansouhada⟧: dry skin
- ⟦{混合|こんごう}{肌|はだ}→混合肌：23961_kongouhada⟧: combination skin
- ⟦{敏感|びんかん}{肌|はだ}→敏感肌：19065_binkanhada⟧: sensitive skin
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: normal skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オイリー⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: oily skin — the English loanword equivalent; more commonly used in cosmetics marketing and younger speech
- {脂|あぶら}ぎった: greasy, oily — an adjective that can describe skin, hair, or food; more vivid and slightly negative

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as {脂性|あぶらせい} in some contexts, though {脂性|あぶらしょう} is the more common reading.
